         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS wins,

  FROM player_matches
  GROUP BY player_api_id
)

FROM (SELECT * FROM player_stats ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1) ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
UNION ALL

FROM (SELECT * FROM player_stats ORDER BY losses DESC LIMIT 1) ps
